message: Hi, I'm a student with a app development certification background. My overall academic average is 72.1% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in programming and cloud computing. I want to become a CRM Technical Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 2800 per year. I live in Chennai. I'm open to anywhere in India.

other_constraints: Interested in programming and cloud computing

explanation:
This MSc Cloud Computing program is highly recommended as it directly aligns with your interest in cloud computing and includes software engineering fields. The annual tuition of $2400 remains within your family's budget constraint. While the minimum required grade (74%) is slightly higher than your 72.1% average, this program offers a strong blend of networking_cloud and software_engineering skills crucial for a Technical Developer role. The main trade-off here is that the location is Coimbatore, which may be less preferred than Chennai.

This program is ideal because it keeps you in Chennai, matching your stated preference, while also focusing on cloud computing. At an extremely low tuition of $550 annually, it easily meets your budget constraint. Although the placement rate (59%) and median starting salary ($7845) are modest compared to other options, its excellent location fit and minimal cost make it a strong contender for immediate consideration.

This MTech program in Pune offers an excellent combination of networking_cloud and software_engineering fields, providing robust technical skills relevant to your career goal. The tuition ($2050) is well within budget, and the placement rate (83%) and median salary ($15192) are among the highest listed options. The main trade-off is that this program requires you to relocate to Pune.

If minimizing cost is your absolute top priority, this MSc Cloud Computing program in Delhi is the best choice. With a tuition of only $950, it significantly reduces financial strain while still focusing on cloud computing. While its curriculum fields are limited to networking_cloud and its placement rate (59%) is low, it provides maximum flexibility regarding your budget constraint.

This MSc Software Engineering program in Mumbai strongly addresses your interest in programming and includes networking_cloud skills. The tuition ($1150) is very affordable, keeping you well under budget. This option provides a solid foundation for software development roles, though the median starting salary ($7933) suggests that further specialization or experience might be needed to reach high developer salaries.
